static_traits.name: Li Bowen
static_traits.social_status: 有几位亲密朋友可倾诉，但他们并not了解这个具体问题
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；此前not yet有类似问题；not yet接受过心理治疗或咨询
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能具体描述经历；思维逻辑较好；语气偏消极但愿意尝试改变；自我Reflection能力较好；在会谈中配合度尚可

basic_info.main_problem: 我倾向于negate正面反馈，只关注负面评论，这影响了我的情绪和自尊。
basic_info.core_demands: Continuously attending to negative feedback has significantly affected my emotions and work performance, so I hope to get help through counseling.
growth_experiences: 开始在本地餐馆担任短单Chef后，逐渐形成只关注负面反馈、negate正面评价的模式；最初压力中等，多由负面的顾客反馈trigger，随着时间推移加重，任何批评都会压过正面反馈。该模式几乎每天在工作中出现，导致Low mood、Impaired self-esteem、与同事关系受影响以及工作失误增多。

core_beliefs: I am a failure/我not胜任我的工作
My value depends on others' evaluations（尤其是顾客的反馈）

special_situations.event: 在一次晚餐服务中，尽管收到了很多称赞，但有一位客人表示not喜欢我的菜，情绪因此受到强烈影响
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果有任何一个人not满意，就说明我做得很差，这一天都被毁了
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复回想那条差评、忽略当晚的称赞，闷闷not乐以期“提醒自己not要再犯错”
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 她not喜欢我的菜，说明我厨艺很差；这一天都被毁了

special_situations.event: In the same shift, receiving both the praise 'the burger is great' and the complaint 'the fries are too salty', with the negative review completely outweighing the positive one
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果连简单的薯条都做not好，我就一定是个失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-reproach and becoming overly tense at work, trying thereby to avoid being criticized again (which instead makes mistakes more likely)
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我连薯条都做not好，I am just a failure

special_situations.event: At work, even when several customers praise me, I still automatically ignore the positive feedback and fixate on one negative review
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 称赞往往not算数，真正反映水平的是批评
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Selectively attends to negative information; tries to remind themselves of positive evaluations but finds it hard to persist, and eventually returns to the negative cycle
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 那些称赞not算数，真正说明问题的是批评

special_situations.event: 在与同事互动时，被负面反馈影响后Low mood、易怒并Avoids communication
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 我应该始终友好、not能有负面情绪，否则就是糟糕的同事
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 强行Repression情绪、减少与同事接触，情绪积累后出现“发火/顶撞”
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我应该更友好，not能让do not人看到我的状态

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and affirmed, proving oneself competent and valuable
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate为“失败者”，害怕他人批评与拒绝
defense_goal: 通过自我苛责和回避他人来降低再次被negate的风险
将挫败感Displacement到更安全的目标上以缓解紧张

object_relations.self_representation: not称职、容易失败、需要他人认可的员工
object_relations.object_representation: 苛刻挑剔、随时可能negate自己的评判者（顾客/他人）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 在工作中收到顾客的负面反馈后与同事互动
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将由顾客反馈引起的挫败与愤怒Displacement到同事身上，把同事体验为“令人恼火”的对象
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气not耐烦、简短回应，减少眼神接触与交流，偶尔出现顶撞或冷处理。

exception_events.target_problem: 在收到正负混合反馈时，Li Bowen通常会忽视称赞、只关注负评，并因此Low mood、表现变差。
exception_events.unique_outcome: Once a customer praised his burger as 'the best I have had in a long time'; he felt very happy in the moment and briefly experienced 'I really did well'.
exception_events.reason: not同支持/情境：正向反馈明确具体且强烈、及时；这种具体化的肯定更容易被注意并短暂地被内化。

positive_force: 愿意尝试改变并参与咨询
能觉察到自身的思维模式（如忽视正面反馈）
在工作中曾获得清晰且强烈的正向反馈
有几位亲密朋友可提供基本支持
negative_force: 持续的心理过滤与negate正面思维模式
非黑即白的自我评价方式导致Impaired self-esteem
Excessively relies on external evaluation to determine self-worth
将挫败感带入同事关系，增加紧张与冲突
工作环境中负面反馈not可避免，trigger频率高，形成恶性循环

target_behavior.behavior: 在收到负面评价后持续反刍负评并negate正面反馈，情绪迅速下降
antecedent: 在同一情境中出现正负混合反馈
target_behavior.core_reason: Self-worth highly depends on others' evaluations, with catastrophizing and black-and-white cognitive patterns
target_behavior.function: 通过自我苛责和聚焦问题来获得控制感与自我纠正的错觉，短期内逃避not确定感与Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood与Impaired self-esteem，注意力分散导致错误增多，Decline in work performance

antecedent: 在工作中刚收到顾客负评后
target_behavior.core_reason: 将对顾客/自我产生的挫败与愤怒Displacement到同事这一更安全的目标上
target_behavior.function: 短期释放紧张情绪并避免进一步的社交暴露
target_behavior.consequence: Damaged relationships with colleagues，团队支持减少，进一步恶化工作氛围与表现
